class.name: DSTextureCache
class.brief_description: Thread-safe least-recently-used cache for DirectStorage textures.
class.description: [DSTextureCache] stores loaded [Texture2D] resources by path and promotes entries when they are read. The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSTextureCache"[/code]. The resource loader uses this cache unless a resource load explicitly ignores caching.

method.name: evict
method.description: Removes the cached texture stored under [param path], if present.

method.name: get_cached
method.description: Returns the cached texture for [param path] and marks it as recently used. Returns [code]null[/code] when no entry exists.

method.name: get_cached_count
method.description: Returns the number of textures currently cached.

method.name: get_max_entries
method.description: Returns the maximum number of entries retained by the cache.

method.name: set_max_entries
method.description: Sets the cache capacity. Values less than [code]1[/code] are clamped to [code]1[/code]; excess oldest entries are evicted immediately.

method.name: store
method.description: Stores [param texture] under [param path] and marks it as recently used. Null textures are ignored.

members.member: Maximum number of textures retained by the least-recently-used cache.
